name: Daisy Cubes Are Strictly Convex-Treelike
statement: Every daisy cube is cover-recursively peripheral, and the four-vertex path is cover-recursively peripheral but is not a daisy cube in any cube orientation.
proof: Sections and projections of a down-set are down-sets, and every nonconstant coordinate of a down-set is peripheral. Thus every nontrivial pc-minor has a periphery. In $P_4$, the middle coordinate is not peripheral, whereas every coordinate of a daisy cube is peripheral.
